infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: YTCash needs camera access to scan banknotes, QR codes and your ID, and to take a selfie for identity verification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: YTCash needs photo library access to select images for scanning.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: YTCash uses your approximate location to show you on the Users Online map, only if you turn that on.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: YTCash uses Face ID to confirm it is you before money leaves your wallet.
